name: Build and Conquer [V0.1]
desc:
The game is still in its BETA version. Expect bugs and constant updates.

Start with an empty plot and build a country that can stand on its own.

Create neighbourhoods, roads, farms, shops, factories, power plants, water networks, and large cities. Manage money, workers, population, resources, happiness, power, research, production, and city expansion as your country grows.

Research new technology, manufacture vehicles and missiles, deploy troops through tunnels to the mainland, form alliances, defend your cities, and fight other nations for control of strategic areas.

Build carefully. A strong economy wins wars, but a strong military protects everything you built.

llm.loop: build a city on an empty plot -> manage economy and resources -> research and manufacture military -> attack or defend against other nations
llm.objectives: build a self-sufficient country and win wars for strategic areas
llm.instructions: build neighbourhoods, roads, farms, factories and infrastructure, manage resources, research, build military and fight other nations
unique: full city-builder economy combined with nation-vs-nation warfare on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: 'Build / Conquer' split images of cities, missiles and tanks, 'defend your airspace'
llm.complexity_notes: many interlocking economy systems, building placement, military units and combat
